answer: In an AI-agent economy coordinating sensor arrays for deep-space comet tracking, Sybil attacks are mitigated through verifiable proof of burn anchored in a Merkle grove. Each agent must irreversibly destroy protocol tokens to mint an operational identity. An attacker incurs a non-refundable capital cost per fake persona, driving their net return to a nadir. However, this mechanism creates a regressive financial barrier that excludes low-capital benign agents.
